##### Project general facts

GEM Residences is a contemporary nine-storey residential development, offering a refined collection of thoughtfully designed apartments. Each residence features spacious layouts and private balconies, providing views of either the tranquil waterfront or the surrounding landscaped greenery. The architecture blends modern design principles with subtle traditional influences, creating a balanced and elegant living environment tailored for comfort and sophistication.

The development offers a wide range of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance everyday living. Residents benefit from adult and children’s swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, landscaped gardens, a dedicated playground, and designated parking spaces. Its strategic location near Al Khan Lagoon ensures seamless connectivity to Corniche Road and Maryam Island Boulevard, where retail outlets, cafés, and open public spaces create a vibrant community atmosphere. Additional outdoor facilities such as jogging tracks, a basketball court, and walking trails further support an active and family-friendly lifestyle.

The interiors are finished with high attention to detail, featuring gypsum ceilings in bathrooms, kitchens, and corridors, cement plaster painted ceilings in living areas and bedrooms, and powder-coated aluminum frames with double-glazed windows. The kitchens are fitted with MDF cabinetry, laminated finishes, stainless steel sinks, and modern bathroom fixtures, ensuring both functionality and durability. The units are offered semi-furnished, providing a practical balance between ready comfort and the flexibility for personal customization.

##### Location description and benefits

Maryam Island, located in the heart of Sharjah along the Al Khan Lagoon and Al Mamzar Corniche, is a premier waterfront community that blends serene natural beauty with modern urban living. The island offers residents a tranquil lifestyle with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, lush green landscapes, and carefully designed promenades. Its pristine beaches provide a peaceful escape, making Maryam Island a haven for relaxation and recreation while being well-connected to the bustling city of Sharjah.

This vibrant community features a range of lifestyle amenities designed to cater to every resident's needs. From world-class retail outlets and waterfront dining options to state-of-the-art fitness centers and playgrounds for children, Maryam Island ensures a comfortable and engaging living experience. Its network of jogging and cycling tracks, as well as recreational areas, promotes a healthy and active lifestyle. The island's marina further enhances the charm of the destination, offering an exclusive spot for boating enthusiasts.

Strategically located, Maryam Island provides seamless access to Sharjah's cultural landmarks, business hubs, and neighboring Dubai. The development is only a short drive from Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport, making it an ideal choice for residents seeking connectivity and convenience. With its luxurious waterfront properties, vibrant community spaces, and close proximity to essential services, Maryam Island represents a perfect balance of comfort, modernity, and natural beauty.
